steps.zh-TW: 註冊前請先確認所在地可以使用 Wirex，並詳讀官方條款。
steps.en: Before registering, check that Wirex is available where you live and read the official terms.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟 Wirex One 的推薦連結（推薦碼已在連結中，會在新分頁開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the Wirex One referral link (the code is already in the link; it opens in a new tab).

steps.zh-TW: 依畫面前往註冊；推薦碼已隨連結帶入，不需要另外輸入（若畫面有推薦碼欄位，請確認內容與本頁的推薦碼相同）。
steps.en: Follow the screens to sign up. The code comes with the link, so there is nothing to type in; if a code field appears, check that it matches this page.

steps.zh-TW: 在註冊表單先看「居住國」選單有沒有你的國家；沒有就請停止，不要為了通過表單改選其他國家。
steps.en: In the sign-up form, check that your country is in the “Country of residence” menu. If it is not, stop; do not pick a different country to get past it.

steps.zh-TW: 如實填寫居住國、電子郵件與密碼並同意條款，再依平台規定完成身分驗證。
steps.en: Enter your real country of residence, email and password, accept the terms, then complete identity verification as the platform requires.

intro.zh-TW: 境外服務，台灣可用性與監管狀態請先閱讀說明。Wirex 是結合錢包與支付卡的加密資產與支付 App；推薦連結已帶推薦碼，不需另外輸入。
intro.en: Overseas service: read the Taiwan availability and regulatory notes first. Crypto wallet and card app; the referral link already carries the referral code.

description.zh-TW:
台灣可用性與監管提醒：Wirex 是境外服務。本站於 2026-10-24 研究時讀取這條連結所接的註冊表單，「居住國」選單沒有台灣（Wirex One 官方說明頁的卡片支援國家清單則列有台灣，頁面未標示年份，該清單談的是卡片支援，不等於可註冊）；本站查閱金管會公布的虛擬資產服務事業名單（2026-09-29 更新，之後的異動未涵蓋）也沒有查到 Wirex。註冊前請先確認所在地可否使用，並自行確認其在台灣的登記與合規狀態。

依 Wirex 官網，Wirex 是 2014 年成立的加密資產與支付服務公司；目前的產品 Wirex One 是結合錢包與支付卡的 App。這是 Wirex One 的推薦連結（短網址 wirex.onelink.me 會轉到 Wirex 官方的 one.wirexapp.com），推薦碼 0xBdd1f71aa0Bf02deEdf6B58CAb02dF3dD5F6b0df 已在連結的 referral_code 參數中。

分享文案只有連結與推薦碼，沒有說明任何優惠，本站因此不列出優惠金額；獎勵的內容、條件與期限以 Wirex 官方公告與推薦計畫條款為準。第三方的加密貨幣卡比較頁（penchan.co，未標示更新日期）把 Wirex One 標為台灣可申請，與本站讀到的註冊表單不一致，請以註冊畫面與 App 內的顯示為準。若所在地可以使用，請直接透過本頁連結註冊。
description.en:
Taiwan availability and regulatory notice: Wirex is an overseas service. When this site read the sign-up form behind this link during research on 2026-10-24, its “Country of residence” menu did not list Taiwan (the card supported-countries list on Wirex One’s official help page does list Taiwan, with no year shown; that list concerns card support and does not show you can register). This site also checked the list of virtual asset service providers published by the Financial Supervisory Commission (updated on 2026-09-29; later changes are not covered) and did not find Wirex. Before you register, check that it is available where you live and check its registration and compliance status in Taiwan yourself.

According to Wirex’s own site, Wirex is a crypto and payments company founded in 2014. Its current product, Wirex One, is an app that combines a wallet with a payment card. This is a referral link for Wirex One (the short link wirex.onelink.me redirects to Wirex's official one.wirexapp.com); the referral code 0xBdd1f71aa0Bf02deEdf6B58CAb02dF3dD5F6b0df is already in the link's referral_code parameter.

The share text contains only the link and the code and does not describe any offer, so this site lists no reward amounts; the details, conditions and deadlines of any reward follow Wirex's official announcements and referral program terms. A third-party crypto card comparison page (penchan.co, no update date shown) marks Wirex One as available to apply for in Taiwan, which does not match the sign-up form this site read; follow the sign-up screen and the app. If it is available where you live, register through the link on this page.

notes.zh-TW:
這是 Wirex One 的推薦連結，推薦碼（referral_code 參數）已在連結中，請直接透過連結註冊。連結的網域 wirex.onelink.me 是 AppsFlyer 的 OneLink 短網址（共用服務，只列這個完整主機），2026-10-28 本站檢查它會轉址到 Wirex 官方的 one.wirexapp.com。分享文案沒有說明優惠，本站不列出優惠金額；獎勵說明若出現，其內容可能隨時變動，請以 Wirex 官方公告與推薦計畫條款為準（依 Wirex 推薦計畫附加條款，Wirex 保留隨時撤回、暫停或變更推薦計畫條款的權利，也不保證每個被推薦的帳戶都會發放獎勵）。本站沒有實際註冊，所以不確定推薦是否會被計入或受理。

Wirex 表示舊版 App 與卡片已於 2026-09-30 停止支援交易（其狀態公告點名歐洲經濟區）；目前的產品是 Wirex One，實際內容請以註冊頁面與 App 內說明為準。註冊表單上有一則註腳寫著「Not available in UK and United States」；2026-10-24 研究時讀取的居住國選單（147 個選項）沒有台灣、英國與美國。各地區是否可使用以官方公告為準。

Wirex 是境外服務。2026-10-24 我們查閱金管會公布的虛擬資產服務事業名單（2026-09-29 更新，之後的異動未涵蓋），沒有查到 Wirex；請自行確認其在台灣的登記與合規狀態，並遵守所在地法規。
notes.en:
This is a referral link for Wirex One. The referral code (the referral_code parameter) is already in the link, so register directly through it. The link domain wirex.onelink.me is an AppsFlyer OneLink short link (a shared service, so only this full host is listed); on 2026-10-28 this site checked that it redirects to Wirex's official one.wirexapp.com. The share text does not describe any offer, so this site lists no reward amounts; any reward text may change at any time, so Wirex's official announcements and referral program terms prevail (under Wirex's refer-a-friend additional terms, Wirex reserves the right to withdraw, suspend or change the referral program's terms at any time and does not guarantee that rewards are paid for every referred account). This site has not registered, so it is not known whether the referral is credited or accepted.

Wirex says its legacy app and card stopped supporting transactions on 2026-09-30 (its status notice names the EEA); its current product is Wirex One, so follow the sign-up page and the in-app information for the actual details. The sign-up form carries a footnote reading “Not available in UK and United States”; the country-of-residence menu (147 options) read during research on 2026-10-24 did not list Taiwan, the UK or the United States. Availability follows Wirex's official announcements.

Wirex is an overseas service. On 2026-10-24 we checked the list of virtual asset service providers published by Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission (updated on 2026-09-29; later changes are not covered) and did not find Wirex; check its registration and compliance status in Taiwan yourself and follow your local laws.

q.zh-TW: 這個推薦連結需要輸入推薦碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need to enter a referral code with this link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要手動輸入。推薦碼 0xBdd1f71aa0Bf02deEdf6B58CAb02dF3dD5F6b0df 已經在連結的 referral_code 參數中，請直接透過本頁連結註冊。本站沒有實際註冊，無法確認畫面上是否顯示這組代碼，或推薦是否會被計入。
a.en: You do not need to type it in. The code 0xBdd1f71aa0Bf02deEdf6B58CAb02dF3dD5F6b0df is already in the link's referral_code parameter, so register through the link on this page. This site has not registered, so it cannot confirm that the code is shown on screen or that the referral is credited.

q.zh-TW: Wirex 在台灣可以註冊嗎？
q.en: Can I sign up for Wirex in Taiwan?

a.zh-TW: 目前看起來不行。2026-10-24 本站研究時讀取這條連結所接的註冊表單，「居住國」選單（147 個選項）沒有台灣。Wirex One 官方說明頁的卡片支援國家清單雖列有台灣（頁面未標示年份），但那是卡片的支援範圍，不能據此判斷可否在台灣註冊。實際情況請以註冊畫面與 App 內的顯示為準，並自行確認所在地法規。
a.en: It looks unlikely. When this site read the sign-up form behind this link during research on 2026-10-24, its “Country of residence” menu (147 options) did not include Taiwan. The card supported-countries list on Wirex One's official help page does include Taiwan (the page shows no year), but that is a list for card support and does not show that you can register in Taiwan. Follow what the sign-up screen and the app show, and check your local regulations.
